purpose: data-only daily history acquisition and source/quality metadata; no small-cap selection and no PnL
source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance in GitHub Actions only
batch_order: source_row ascending from frozen current IDX roster
retry_policy: retry on HTTP 429/rate-limit and transient network/5xx errors; non-transient errors are captured exactly and stop early; never substitute another source
invalid_bar_policy: preserve raw rows and log invalid/blank OHLC; no interpolation or automatic repair
note: Current active listing queue is for acquisition only. Even complete bars remain survivorship-biased and do not establish a historical small-cap universe or alpha.
